int_name: GLEN ECHO RD & S MOUNT PLEASANT RD

result.summary: This is a narrow residential street with heavy tree cover and minimal pedestrian infrastructure. While traffic volume appears low, the lack of marked crossings and a formal sidewalk on one side forces pedestrians into the roadway or onto unpaved shoulders.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The left side of the roadway lacks a paved sidewalk, forcing pedestrians onto a dirt path or into the travel lane.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense vegetation and the curve of the road limit sight lines for both drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the road ahead

hazards.name: Lack of Lighting
hazards.description: No street lighting is visible, which would significantly decrease safety during dawn, dusk, or nighttime.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Install a continuous, paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and security along the corridor.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim back overhanging or encroaching vegetation to improve sight lines around curves.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and a sidewalk on the left side. While the low-speed residential context is favorable, safety is compromised by significant sightline obstructions from dense vegetation and a lack of accessible curb ramps.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense, overgrown vegetation on the left corner completely blocks sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground corner adjacent to the sidewalk and crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: There are no visible ADA-compliant curb ramps, creating a barrier for pedestrians with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: At the transition between the sidewalk and the crosswalk on the left.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Trim or remove the dense vegetation at the corner to ensure clear sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install standard curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at both ends of the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install W11-2 pedestrian warning signs to alert drivers to the presence of the crossing.

result.summary: A residential street with a partial sidewalk on one side and dense vegetation on the other. The environment lacks continuous pedestrian paths and clear crossing infrastructure, with sight lines potentially limited by the road's curve and foliage.

hazards.name: Discontinuous Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left appears to end or transition, and there is no sidewalk on the right, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the road and mid-ground left.

hazards.name: Limited Sight Lines
hazards.description: Dense vegetation on the right side of the curve may obstruct the view between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Extension
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on both sides of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian crossing area.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim back trees and bushes on the inside of the curve to improve sight distances for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a paved sidewalk or multi-use path bordered by dense, unmanaged vegetation and mature trees. No roadway, traffic signals, or crossing infrastructure are visible from this perspective, making it difficult to assess the full pedestrian context.

hazards.name: Dense Vegetation
hazards.description: Overhanging and adjacent foliage limits sightlines and could conceal hazards or people.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the background and right side of the image

hazards.name: Lack of Lighting
hazards.description: No visible street lights, which may make the path feel unsafe or be difficult to navigate at night.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install lighting along the path to improve visibility and perceived safety during evening hours.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Prune trees and shrubs to maintain clear sightlines and ensure the full width of the path is usable.
